name: Shafeeq S
intro: Cybersecurity student focused on Blue Team operations — SOC investigations, malware analysis, threat detection, and building practical security tools. Deepening skills through hands-on LetsDefend labs, independent research projects, and formal internship experience with the Government of Tamil Nadu.
aboutParagraph1: I'm a Computer Science and Business Systems student at Panimalar Engineering College, interested in cybersecurity, especially SOC investigations, malware analysis, and digital forensics.
aboutParagraph2: I enjoy investigating security alerts, exploring suspicious files, and using tools like Wireshark and Procmon to understand what's happening on a system. I also build security projects and write about the investigations and techniques I work on.
ctaText: Interested in cybersecurity, threat detection, or AI security?
ctaSub: Open to internships, collaborations, and conversations.
